source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Identify the advertised specification.
3. Record the test method used.
4. State the observed product performance.
5. Compare advertised specification against actual performance.
6. Use objective language and avoid subjective interpretations.
7. Document all tests and results, even if they show partial failure.
8. Provide relevant data and graphs if available.
9. Highlight each failed advertised specification separately.
10. Include photos or videos as evidence when necessary.
11. Reference the source of the advertised specification.
12. Maintain a professional tone throughout the report.
13. Include the testing environment and conditions that may have affected the results.
14. Note any variations or exceptions observed during testing.
15. Attach any relevant correspondence with the manufacturer for clarification or dispute.
16. Ensure any relevant standards or protocols were followed in the testing process.
17. Provide a concise summary of each failed specification result.
18. Include the date of testing, the product serial number or other identifying marks.
19. Include
